serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-model-scanner
serverInfo.description: MCP server that scans ML model files (PyTorch, pickle, safetensors, Keras/H5, ONNX) for supply-chain risks — malicious pickle deserialization gadgets, disguised/malformed safetensors headers, Keras Lambda-layer RCE, and ONNX external-data path traversal

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single ML model file for supply-chain risks: dangerous Python globals reachable during pickle deserialization (os/subprocess/eval/socket/etc, including inside PyTorch's zip checkpoint container), a malformed or disguised .safetensors header, a Keras Lambda-layer RCE pattern in .h5/.keras files, or a path-traversal external_data reference in .onnx files.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the model file (.pt, .pth, .ckpt, .pkl, .pickle, .bin, .safetensors, .h5, .hdf5, .keras, .onnx)

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory for ML model files and report supply-chain risks in each. Automatically skips node_modules, .git, venv, and other non-model directories.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 2000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every dangerous Python global (module.function) this scanner treats as a red flag when found referenced inside a pickled model file, grouped by risk category
